question.text: The actinoids exhibits more number of oxidation states in general than the lanthanoids. This is because

options.text: the $5 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals are more buried than the $4 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals
there is a similarity between $4 \mathrm{f}$ and $5 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals in their angular part of the wave function
the actinoids are more reactive than the lanthanoids
the $5 f$ orbitals extend further from the nucleus than the $4 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals

solution.text:
The actinoids exhibit more number of oxidation states in general than the lanthanoids. This is because the $5 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals extend further from the nucleus than the $4 \mathrm{f}$ orbitals.
Hence, (D) is correct.
